_meta.data_caveats: Play Store, AppGoblin and Similarweb pages could not be fetched directly (network-blocked in this environment). Install counts/ratings come from third-party tracker snippets surfaced via web search; treat as approximate. Direct 1-star/3-star review mining of 20+20+10 reviews per competitor (Step 3) could NOT be performed; complaint themes below are drawn from secondary sources (Quash release-health analysis of 3,000 Testbook reviews, Trustpilot, Unstar, news reports) and are flagged as partial.

direct_competitors.name: Testbook
direct_competitors.estimated_users: 50M+ Play installs (AppBrain cross-listing); company claims 5+ crore registered users (marketing claim)
direct_competitors.last_updated: Actively maintained (frequent releases per Quash release-health)
direct_competitors.pricing: Free alerts/notifications + free tests; unified Testbook Pass ~INR 674-749/year (list INR 1,199); legacy Pass Pro INR 499/mo or INR 699/yr on iOS listing
top_features: Free job alerts / exam notifications and SEO notification pages
top_complaints: App failures/bugs (8.7% of 3,000 reviews analysed describe app failing - Quash)

direct_competitors.name: Adda247
direct_competitors.estimated_users: 10M+ installs across developer account (AppBrain); claims 40-50M monthly users, ~2M paid (company claims)
direct_competitors.pricing: App free; listing advertises 'Exam Notification, Govt. Job Alerts' free; paid courses/test series/Mahapack (price not confirmed in this run)
top_features: Free daily GK/current affairs, PYQs, e-books
distribution_channels_observed: Massive SEO footprint (adda247.com/jobs, bankersadda, sscadda, careerpower)

direct_competitors.name: FreeJobAlert.com app
top_features: Aggregated job notices (from a public Google Sheet per listing)

direct_competitors.name: Sarkari Result sites and clone apps (sarkariresult.com, sarkariexam.com, rojgarresult.com, dozens of 'Sarkari Result' Play apps)
direct_competitors.estimated_users: Head keyword 'sarkari result' ~79-124M searches/mo; individual clone apps 0.5K-113K installs (AppGoblin)
top_features: Latest jobs / admit card / result / answer key lists
top_complaints: Clutter and ads; impersonation/clone confusion; 'not a government app' disclaimers; fake recruitment notices risk (govt warnings)

direct_competitors.name: Eligibility matchers: Sarkari Scan (Android), India Govt Job Finder (iOS), TrueJobs (web eligibility checker)
top_features: Match by education, age, category, experience

direct_competitors.name: Oliveboard / Physics Wallah (PW) / Unacademy / Prepp / Rojgar with Ankit app
direct_competitors.estimated_users: PW and Unacademy tens of millions overall; Rojgar with Ankit YouTube ~20M subs
direct_competitors.pricing: PW govt batches INR 399-1,999 (SSC CHSL 2026 Standard INR 1,499); Oliveboard ~INR 1,899 (unconfirmed product)
direct_competitors.pricing_model: paid batches; free alerts/blogs as funnel

indirect_competitors.name: YouTube govt-job news creators (Rojgar with Ankit ~20M subs; Recruitment Hub ~1.1M; Rojgar Samachar India ~573K)
indirect_competitors.approach: Daily 'new vacancy' videos + notifications via YouTube bell
indirect_competitors.why_users_choose_it: Already where aspirants spend time; explanation + motivation + trust in a face; free

indirect_competitors.name: Official portals and apps (mySSC app, UMANG exam calendar, ssc.gov.in, rrbapply.gov.in, IBPS, state PSC sites)
indirect_competitors.approach: Authoritative source; mySSC allows full application in-app since June 2025 (Aadhaar OTP + face recognition)
indirect_competitors.why_users_choose_it: Must use them to apply anyway; zero trust risk

indirect_competitors.name: Coaching-institute WhatsApp groups and Telegram alert channels
indirect_competitors.approach: Push alerts with PDFs into chats users already check hourly
indirect_competitors.why_users_choose_it: Zero install, zero cost, social; delivery reliability better than app push on Indian OEM phones

substitutes.switching_cost_to_app: Must install and fill a profile; benefit only felt when an alert arrives that the user would have missed
High noise but already habitual; app must be visibly more accurate and less noisy

substitutes.description: Friends, coaching teachers, local cyber cafe operator (who also fills the form for INR 30-150)
substitutes.switching_cost_to_app: Cyber cafe does the whole job (find + fill + pay); app only notifies

substitutes.description: Doing nothing / relying on newspaper Employment News (Rojgar Samachar)
substitutes.switching_cost_to_app: Low urgency until a deadline is actually missed

emerging_threats.name: mySSC official app (SSC)
emerging_threats.notes: Government-backed, Android-only, OTR + full applications in-app from June 2025; any SSC-only alert value is subsumed. Other boards may follow.

emerging_threats.name: Edtech incumbents adding personalized exam feeds (Testbook/Adda247 already capture target exam at onboarding)
emerging_threats.notes: Any proven personalization angle is a sprint-sized feature for them; they already have the target-exam profile and 10-50M installs.

emerging_threats.name: AI assistants / Google AI Overviews answering 'when is <exam> last date'
emerging_threats.notes: Erodes pull-based lookup; does not yet provide proactive push.

review_mining_summary.most_common_complaint_across_competitors: Noise and untrustworthiness (ads, upsell/sales pressure, clone sites, stale or fake notices) — inferred from secondary sources, NOT from systematic 1/3/5-star mining (data gap).
review_mining_summary.strongest_gap_signal: Trust + signal-to-noise: aspirants subscribe to many free channels because none is reliably complete AND quiet. Also: no free option does the 'act on it' step (form filling) that cyber cafes charge INR 30-150 for.

positioning_gaps.description: Verified, source-linked, ad-light alerts with zero upsell calls — positioned against noisy aggregators and sales-heavy edtechs
positioning_gaps.evidence: Trustpilot complaints on Testbook sales calls/refunds; govt warnings about fake recruitment notices; clone apps carrying 'not a government app' disclaimers

positioning_gaps.description: Vernacular, state-level recruitment (state police, patwari, TET, state PSC) for a single state where national players' coverage is thinner
positioning_gaps.evidence: Hinglish head term; state-specific alert apps exist with small installs (e.g., Sarkari Job Alerts Rajasthan ~113K installs per AppGoblin) — demand exists, quality is low

positioning_gaps.description: Eligibility-precise personalization (DOB on cut-off date, category relaxations, domicile, qualification) for ALL boards in one feed
positioning_gaps.evidence: Already offered by Sarkari Scan, India Govt Job Finder, TrueJobs checker; incumbents can copy in a sprint

positioning_gaps.description: 'Do it for me' — from alert to completed application (documents, photo/signature resizing, fee reminders)
positioning_gaps.evidence: Cyber cafe/CSC charges INR 30-150 per form; news reports of aspirants failing to apply due to portal congestion near deadlines

differentiation_opportunities: Trust/quiet positioning: 'only the alerts you are eligible for, each linked to the official PDF, no sales calls'
Single-state vernacular depth (e.g., one Hindi-belt state's police/teacher/patwari recruitments)
Move from notify to act: application-readiness checklist and assisted form prep (monetizable per transaction)
